fixedMask: R<125 and G<145 and B>R (all uint8 original pixels)
opening: PIL MinFilter(k) then MaxFilter(k) on white=selectedblue mask; no thresholdsweep
selection: 8-connected components after opening; select largest component touching cropbottom. Report no component as unresolved.
outputs: For both openings maskPNG, originalcrop+thinboundaryoverlay with sourcecoordgrid, probe results, boundarypixel coordinates. If constructing ordered edge loops, expose ambiguousvertices and do not claim orderedinterface when nonunique.

success: Both fixed probe sets pass AND independent scan/overlay review finds actualW/F boundary/attachment/order interpretable without lost relevant anatomy. Probe passes alone insufficient.
stop: Unresolved if probe failure, lost relevant anatomy, interpretations disagree, or attachment/order remains ambiguous. No threshold/probe/crop change, no productiontracing or constructionapproval.
